description: Persistent memory and context layer for AI agents. inject() before your LLM call, update() after. Relevance-scored injection, grant-based access control, user-owned context. Works with OpenAI, Anthropic, Vercel AI SDK, and LangChain. < 50ms retrieval. GDPR-ready. Free tier: 2,500 calls/month.

findings.title: Insecure Secret Handling

findings.recommendation: Avoid accepting raw credentials as input parameters. Use secret managers (e.g. 1Password CLI, AWS Secrets Manager) and ensure credentials are never logged or stored in agent traces.
